Maya Patel: Quick sync — we're running a Seed preview quickstart coaching series for Vectorly next week. Need 20‑min office‑hour slots to finish onboarding checklist, confirm SSO, and capture a 3‑question micro‑survey. Volunteers to lead and someone to capture the short feedback?
Jordan Lee: I can take Tue 10:30 PT (20 min). I'll demo the SSO flow and the in‑product checklist.
Ravi Singh: Heads up — Vectorly reported SSO provisioning errors in staging earlier today. I've pinged eng‑infra.
Ava Gomez: I can prep a 2‑slide quickstart + a screenshot of the checklist. Will upload draft.
Maya Patel: Proposed slots (please add to shared calendar if you claim one):
```
Tue 10:30-10:50 PT - Jordan
Wed 13:00-13:20 PT - Maya
Thu 16:00-16:20 PT - Ava
```
Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/seed-quickstart
OnboardBot: Event created: Seed Preview quickstart — Tue 10:30 PT (added Maya, Jordan, Ava)
Jordan Lee: Draft outreach copy to customer before session:
> Hi — quick 20‑min session to finish setup & capture two quick bits of feedback. Please bring your SSO logs if you can. Link: <cal invite>
Also propose we ask them these 3 micro‑survey Qs:
```
1) How easy was the setup? (1-5)
2) What blocked you most? (short free text)
3) Would you recommend Redwood to a teammate? (Y/N)
```
Ava Gomez: Can we also include an in‑product checklist screenshot in the invite? I'll snap one and attach here.
Ravi Singh: I opened infra ticket #INC-4821. Short summary: SAML provisioning fails for team `vectorly`. Eng assigned: @Sam.
Sam (eng-infra): Looking into it. Quick ask — can you provide the customer's SAML metadata file + any timestamped logs? That will speed debugging.
Maya Patel: I'll request logs from Vectorly in the pre‑session message so we don't waste time. Also plan to record the session and clip a 2‑min highlight for PM.
Jordan Lee: For feedback capture, let's use the 'seed-microsurvey' form (quick + exportable). Form link: https://forms.redwood.com/seed-microsurvey
Ava Gomez: I'll draft the calendar invite copy. Maya — want me to add a line asking them to fill the tiny form and attach logs beforehand? :point_down: 
Maya Patel: Yes please — ask for logs + form completion. Also flagging renewal risk: Vectorly is on a 6‑month pilot; if onboarding stalls >2 weeks we escalate. @Chris Nguyen FYI.
Chris Nguyen: Thanks — noted. If SSO persists >48h escalate to enterprise support and I’ll join the next sync.
Jordan Lee: I'll lead Tue slot and send pre‑reads and the sample DM to the customer. :thumbsup: 
Sam (eng-infra): Got a partial metadata file from Ravi, will post precise log request once parsed.
OnboardBot: Reminder scheduled 24h before event Tue 10:30 PT.
Maya Patel: Perfect. Recording + survey plan in place. Ava — ping me when the invite draft is ready and I'll ship the outreach.
